about.description:
Pango is a library for laying out and rendering of text, with an emphasis
on internationalization. Pango can be used anywhere that text layout is
needed, though most of the work on Pango so far has been done in the
context of the GTK widget toolkit. Pango forms the core of text and font
handling for GTK.

script.content:
import gi
gi.require_version("PangoCairo", "1.0")
from gi.repository import PangoCairo

families = PangoCairo.FontMap.get_default().list_families()
assert families, "no font families found"

script: pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" pango pangocairo pangoft2 pangofc pangoot

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.58.2"
  version_majmin: ${{ (version | split("."))[:2] | join(".") }}

recipe:
  name: pango-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.gnome.org/sources/pango/${{ version_majmin }}/pango-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 342385b6ca3b7c73455d7c80a13b7dbe4489e00bc3bd4c5bd6ed4dce421e374a

build:
  number: 3

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: pango-build
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "build.sh" if unix else "build.bat" }}
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
        - gobject-introspection
        # build.sh does a native build to generate the introspection data
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - cairo
            - expat
            - fribidi
            - glib
            - libharfbuzz-devel
            - fontconfig
            - freetype
            - libpng
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - zlib
      host:
        - cairo
        - fribidi
        - glib
        - libharfbuzz-devel
        - fontconfig
        - freetype
        # Not linked; only here because the .pc files of the libraries above
        # require them (fontconfig.pc, cairo.pc, gio-2.0.pc, libpng16.pc, x11.pc)
        - expat
        - libpng
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib

  - package:
      name: libpango
    inherit: pango-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - lib/libpango*.so*
            - lib/libpango*.dylib
            - lib/girepository-1.0/Pango*.typelib
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/pango*.dll
            - Library/lib/girepository-1.0/Pango*.typelib
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
        overdepending_behavior: error
    requirements:
      # the sysroot has to be in this output's build env for the linking check
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
          - expat
          - libpng
          - zlib
    tests:
      - script:
          interpreter: python
          content: |
            import gi
            gi.require_version("PangoCairo", "1.0")
            from gi.repository import PangoCairo

            families = PangoCairo.FontMap.get_default().list_families()
            assert families, "no font families found"
        requirements:
          run:
            - pygobject
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          files:
            - if: linux
              then: lib/libpango*-1.0.so*
            - if: osx
              then: lib/libpango*-1.0.*dylib
            - if: unix
              then: lib/girepository-1.0/Pango*-1.0.typelib
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/bin/pango-1.0-0.dll
                - Library/bin/pangocairo-1.0-0.dll
                - Library/bin/pangoft2-1.0-0.dll
                - Library/bin/pangowin32-1.0-0.dll
                - Library/lib/girepository-1.0/Pango*-1.0.typelib

  - package:
      name: libpango-devel
    inherit: pango-build
    build:
      files:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - bin/pango-*
            - include/pango-1.0/
            - lib/pkgconfig/pango*.pc
            - share/gir-1.0/Pango*.gir
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/pango-*.exe
            - Library/include/pango-1.0/
            - Library/lib/pango*-1.0.lib
            - Library/lib/pkgconfig/pango*.pc
            - Library/share/gir-1.0/Pango*.gir
      dynamic_linking:
        overlinking_behavior: error
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpango', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpango', exact=True) }}
        # pango's public headers and .pc files reach these, but the runtime
        # packages libpango pulls in (libharfbuzz, libfreetype) lack them
        - freetype
        - libharfbuzz-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpango', upper_bound='x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
          - expat
          - libpng
          - zlib
    tests:
      - script:
          # renders through cairo, fontconfig, freetype and harfbuzz
          - pango-view --no-display --text "Hello, World" --output hello.png
          - if: unix
            then: test -s hello.png
            else: if not exist hello.png exit 1
          - pkg-config --print-errors --exact-version "${{ version }}" pango pangocairo pangoft2 pangofc pangoot
        requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
            # .pc files that pango's dependencies require but do not provide
            - expat           # fontconfig.pc
            - xorg-xorgproto  # x11.pc and the other xorg .pc files cairo.pc pulls in
            - zlib            # gio-2.0.pc, cairo.pc, libpng16.pc
      - package_contents:
          strict: true
          include:
            - pango-1.0/pango/pango.h
          bin:
            - pango-list
            - pango-segmentation
            - pango-view
          files:
            - if: unix
              then:
                - include/pango-1.0/pango/*.h
                - lib/pkgconfig/pango*.pc
                - share/gir-1.0/Pango*-1.0.gir
            - if: win
              then:
                - Library/include/pango-1.0/pango/*.h
                - Library/lib/pango*-1.0.lib
                - Library/lib/pkgconfig/pango*.pc
                - Library/share/gir-1.0/Pango*-1.0.gir

  # compatibility wrapper, so existing `pango` host deps keep getting the
  # development files
  - package:
      name: pango
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpango-devel', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpango', upper_bound='x') }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          strict: true

about:
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file: COPYING
  summary: Text layout and rendering engine.
  description: |
    Pango is a library for laying out and rendering of text, with an emphasis
    on internationalization. Pango can be used anywhere that text layout is
    needed, though most of the work on Pango so far has been done in the
    context of the GTK widget toolkit. Pango forms the core of text and font
    handling for GTK.
  homepage: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/pango
  repository: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/pango
  documentation: https://docs.gtk.org/Pango/

extra:
  feedstock-name: pango
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ocefpaf
    - ccordoba12
    - jakirkham
    - pkgw
